notes.title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is Out Now! ⚔️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/f92a4d80d0acad119963abf1a4d58e667ddacae0.jpg[/img]

Greetings friends!!!
We have some great news to share with you today.

[b]Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is now available on Steam! We are offering a special 15% discount during the launch period.[/b]
The game is also available on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139840/Skelethrone_The_Chronicles_of_Ericona/

At its core this is a Souls-like game that features Metroidvania elements, filled with exploration and secrets to be found.

You're in for a great adventure inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Bloodthirsty monsters, divine creatures and epic boss battles. The game’s story is shaped by choices that will define your journey.

[h3]Let's celebrate the game's launch![/h3]
In honor of the release, please watch the trailer and immerse yourself in the world of Makh-Abyss before fully exploring the story and finding out what actually happened after the death of Lord Derek Ericona.

[previewyoutube=PtAhNjGXCuY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update! Improvements, bug fixes and new features.
notes.content:
It is a pleasure to present the new update of Robo Do It; Which includes some improvements, bug fixes and new features.

New Features:
- Now players can compare their results with other players and appreciate how good you are playing Robo Do It with the new player ranking!
- A global ranking has been added to the main screen that displays the best players in Arcade mode, Level Editor, or both.
- A ranking for each level has also been added in the respective level’s details window that shows the top 10 of the best players of that level.
- To give a little plus to Robo Do It, an instant messaging system has been added on the game’s main screen. Now you are able to communicate with any player that is on the main screen of Robo Do It!

Improvements:
- All levels available in arcade mode are unlocked, you can now play any level in arcade mode without having to solve the previous level!
- New backgrounds were added on the loading screen, which are randomly displayed to give a little impression to the player while waiting.
- Also added more background music while you navigate the game's menus.
- Other minor improvements were made.

Bugs fixed:
- Fixed an error which showed badly the number of results in the level finder.
- Fixed an error which showed some direction arrows of the mobile platform when it changed its direction.
- Other minor errors were fixed.
